blocking_human_decisions.evidence: At native size the word reads as HISS (independent review of compare/*.x12.png). Frame 65 (dim ink 0xEE over shadow 0xEF) has lower contrast.

defaults: D1 (revisable): lettering source is the MAINROM sheet 0x16000 logo-line capitals (frame 118 part 19), worded as original disc art referenced by frame 118; on-screen use unproven.
D2 (revisable): text is uppercase MISS; the compact face has no lowercase.

D3 (revisable): M is the verified 3-wide #.#/###/#.#/#.#/#.# glyph at x17 y21; a search of all ten MAINROM sheets found no isolated wider M (judge-reported STADIUM M at x97 y74 not found), so no variant B; may read as HISS, needs human readability check.
D4 (revisable): pure (+1,+1) shadow with the region shadow index (0x12 bright, 0xEF dim); the original hand-placed counter-shadow pixels are not reproduced.
D5 (revisable): ink bottom anchored to the source lettering ink bottom (row 6); 5-row face in a 6-row slot; 1-px tracking; centred with the shadow column.
D6 (revisable): items bound to frames 64 (bright) and 65 (dim) part 0, page0 u40 v72 / u40 v80, 16x8.
D7 (revisable): PARK/UTYU/VS_PARK/VS_UTYU recorded as a scope note only, not drafted.
D8 (revisable): Miss drafts are a separate revision (battle-miss-drafts-v1) so the published battle-drafts-v1 manifest and 30 command drafts stay byte-identical.
